rules.trigger: {"type":"subject_or_snippet_contains_any","patterns":["tracking number","tracking #","shipment","your order has shipped","on the way","scheduled delivery","estimated delivery","out for delivery","will arrive today","arriving today","arrives today"]}
rules.notes: Tracking numbers may appear in subject or body. retailer_or_sender falls back to email sender name if no retailer is mentioned. Applies to any carrier or seller. If tracking number is not extractable, omit gracefully. Surface delivery window when available.

Repository invitations. T2 — requires deliberate action (accept or decline). Other GitHub notification types handled by separate rules when examples arrive.
RPG announcement emails. T4 — user wants to investigate content. Rule added based on single example; may need refinement.
Mention notifications on Medium. T4 — user wants to read the context. Comment notifications from same sender are T2 — add rule when example arrives.

Return deadline reminders. T2 — action required before deadline. Note: Amazon sometimes issues refunds without requiring a return; investigate if a return reminder arrives for an already-refunded item.
Order confirmations from Grubhub. Sender is orders@eat.grubhub.com. T3 — glance and archive. Summarizer should extract restaurant name and delivery ETA.

Transactional emails — order confirmations and upcoming subscription notices. order appears in snippet for both types. T3 — glance and archive.

Product announcements, feature updates, and platform news from Kit (formerly ConvertKit). T4 — read to stay current on platform capabilities for Rambling Reggie account.

Survey completion receipt. T3 — glance and archive. financial_summary should capture whatever is most relevant: order total if available, or credit remaining and shipping status if not. Example: 'Cats Among The Cosmos — credit remaining $0.00, shipping charged later'.

Pre-launch and discovery notifications from BackerKit. Sender format is creator+[variable]@o.backerkit.com — domain match catches all regardless of campaign. Typically from creators already followed. T4 — user wants to read content and possibly click through to back the campaign.

rules.digestSummaryTemplate: BackerKit digital content available: {campaign} — download and add to reading list
rules.notes: Any new digital content email is T2. Generate action item: download content and add to reading list.
Same reading order rules as BackerKit. Full content must be accessible. Escalate to T2 if survey, pledge change, address confirmation, or download required.

Campaign update emails from BackerKit. Read in chronological order within campaign. When creator has multiple campaigns, read all their updates chronologically across campaigns. Full email content must be accessible — digest is navigation aid only. If update contains survey, pledge change, address confirmation, or download: escalate to T2.

Daily at midnight. Errors=0: T3 one-liner. Errors>0 first day: T2, note self-resolution possible. Errors>0 second consecutive day: T2 + action item. Missing first day: T1 note. Missing second consecutive day: T1 + action item. Agent must track last N days of outcomes.

rules.digestSummaryTemplate: Ohio BMV: vehicle registration renewal due for {vehicle} — renew by {deadline}
rules.notes: Ohio BMV vehicle registration renewal reminder. T2 — specific action required (renew online or in person) but ~2 months lead time given. Two vehicles currently registered. Email arrives via BCC so toRecipients shows No-Reply@dps.ohio.gov — must trigger on sender, not address. If vehicle is no longer owned, disregard.
